frontmatter.title: Am I Vulnerable? How to Audit Your GitHub Actions for the pull_request_target Flaw
frontmatter.subheading: A practical guide to finding and fixing the common misconfiguration that allows untrusted code to run with privileged access.
frontmatter.excerpt: Audit your GitHub workflows for a critical security flaw. This guide helps you identify if your use of `pull_request_target` is checking out untrusted code.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
